sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's revised RUPTL and mandatory carbon trading are driving structural demand for geothermal and solar IPPs, benefiting TOBA and BRPT.
EV adoption in Indonesia is accelerating via nickel downstreaming and battery ecosystem, lifting VKTR and charging infrastructure plays.
Global climate-tech capex is shifting to energy storage and grid modernization, supporting SEDG and POWR despite US policy uncertainty.
sectors.ai: Buy the dip in Indonesian renewables leaders TOBA, BRPT, and TPIA on the government's accelerated RUPTL revision and carbon trading momentum; US names SEDG and POWR offer beta but face rate risk. Add PADA and SIPD for mid-cap upside. Trim any laggards into strength; rotate into leaders before the next leg.
